button_2110 lie inside antiportal_2085 (scale 3, 96 px at 32 x scale), behind door_lift_2111, which only
that button raises; every portal here is 98.5 px or more from the ring's centre (the launch exit at
(252, 40) is the nearest). THE WAY ONTO THE PLATFORM IS THE LIGHT WALL PUT BACK. The wall at (288, 128)
plugs the 32-unit gap between single_block_plat_2088 and double_block_plat_2081 and its top (y 65) is a
bridge flush with both, but it stands in the way of the shot that takes the player to the left side, so
the torch takes it away and the torch's own orbiting flame, shot, puts the torch out and builds it again
(sim/Torch: 'a toggle, not an unlock'). The player never has to be carried over the gap, which the 0.86 air
brake of step 148 forbids (it carries 14.7 units): he walks over the wall.

player who steps on the spinning platform swings it to its stop, and a walk back right along the top then
ends against it at x 520 (measured), and this route comes back along the top. A shot lights the torch (131, lit 170, the

above the line of a shot at the lower left from about tick 320. A portal at (200, 150) (322, open 387); the

middle. A portal on the left ledge at (150, 20) (443) and one on the player (501). A portal at (252, 40)

upper platform; he stops at x 327.8 against door_lift_2104's raised top until it has fallen (~740: it
latches 6000 ms from tick 205), then right: the key (754), button_2110 (757) and door_lift_2111, through it
and along the top over the level spinning platform, off its end into the pocket (889). The torch again (892,

block's face at x 313.2 (1085). A portal above single_block_plat_2164 at (296, 165) (1090) and one on the
player (1118): onto the step block, where the key is within 26 of the keyhole and the yellow door goes. A
portal at (250, 120) (1146) and one on the player (1172): into the left room; left into the door. Won on
